title: That's Too Easy (LeBron)
blurb: 'That's too easy.' — LeBron James dismissing a challenge that other people find difficult. It's the ultimate low-effort flex: no celebration, no gloating, just a statement of fact about the gap in skill. Play it after solving something trivially, or ironically after barely surviving something that was in fact extremely hard.
origin: LeBron James's viral 'that's too easy' dismissal.
